avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations up to 8 days later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 6 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Rainy Pass (4,880 ft) and the second highest at Swamp Creek (3,930 ft).

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 30 and July 31, carried from the melt-out dates at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Rainy Pass (4,880 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Rainy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 2, 2,053 ft below the pass; points to June 1 to August 14
